USAGE:
  sediment report abandonment [-h] [--org ORG] [--json]
                              [--database-url DATABASE_URL]
                              [--mirror-path MIRROR_PATH]
                              [--grace-horizon-days GRACE_HORIZON_DAYS]

  Accepted Session status from captured Session-to-commit observations.

OPTIONS:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --org ORG             org id (default: $SEDIMENT_ORG_ID)
  --json                emit a JSON row instead of a table
  --database-url DATABASE_URL
                        PostgreSQL URL (default: $SEDIMENT_DATABASE_URL)
  --mirror-path MIRROR_PATH
                        base dir for git mirrors (default: $SEDIMENT_MIRROR_PATH
                        or './mirrors')
  --grace-horizon-days GRACE_HORIZON_DAYS
                        legacy horizon for policy compatibility; missing
                        observations remain unknown (default: 14)
